blocks.text: PHOENIX — Cooper Flagg scored 34 points and led a late Dallas charge in a 113-109 victory over the Phoenix Suns that left the Mavericks perfect in NBA Cup group play. Dallas had already wrapped up West Group A by winning its first three Cup games. The Suns were 1-3 in the competition, squandering a 21-point lead against the Mavericks. Flagg also has eight assists, seven rebounds, five steals and four blocks in just under 42 minutes. Dallas has won five in a row.
